revision_instructions: Remove page identifiers from all card facts while preserving the bounded content.

Change the role to a source-supported formulation such as `ROLE: Member of the raiding party involved in capturing Shazam` unless another provided source explicitly supports the genetic-recreation detail.
Narrow the boundary line to the confirmed record, e.g. Bargoth is individually confirmed in the horse extraction and later missing-call sequence, with no additional role or fate confirmed.
unsupported_claims: `ROLE: Member of the armed raiding party that stole Shazam, the genetically recreated horse` adds `genetically recreated horse`, which is not supported by the provided Bargoth source record.

`BOUNDARY: ... no separate role confirmed in the initial breach beyond membership in the raiding party` references the initial breach, but the Bargoth source record only supports the horse extraction and later missing call, not Bargoth's individual involvement in a breach sequence.
